title: Record the trace-zero call floor
body:
## Summary
- There are 21 trace-zero rank-one matrices on three bits. An explicit pair has diagonal zero and cross scalar one, so a trace-zero factor can feed the corner.
- The stacked rank does not read that diagonal, so each side still needs six calls. The twelve-call word still attains the bound.
- Partial, no new kappa. This records that floor. It does not search words.

## Test plan
